authority: MT5 optimizer evidence + Python canonical qualification/revalidation + explicit Owner selection.
entry_condition: Optimizer job has QUALIFIED_POOL_READY evidence and Owner opens/selects from the active qualified pool.
failure_behavior: Stale/rejected/consumed/mismatched candidate aborts before legal registry mutation.
Partial post-directory state becomes recovery-required rather than invented success.
invariants: Consumed source tuple cannot re-enter active pool while durable registry or COMMITTED batch authority remains.
Every selected candidate is canonically revalidated before mutation.
purpose: Expose only canonically qualified and unconsumed optimizer rows, require explicit Owner selection, revalidate every source tuple, then commit immutable Challenger batch/registry authority.
restart_behavior: Resume/recovery uses persisted deterministic batch/job authority and never silently duplicates committed consumption.
rollback_behavior: Pre-commit failure leaves no eligible phantom Challenger; immutable accepted prior evidence is not rewritten.
title: Optimizer result to qualified pool, Owner selection and Challenger registration

transitions.action: Owner explicitly selects one or more active job/round/pass tuples.
Revalidate every candidate against retained report/sidecar/request/baseline/hard gates.
Validate/stage immutable Challenger bundles then atomically commit batch and registry.
